rv.q: His attention to dynamics enlivened the vibrant, supple carpet of orchestral sound, an important factor in making this performance so moving.
This production is certainly for someone.

cn.t: Critics are divided on Michael Mayer's lavish production, with some finding the opulent visuals garish and overwrought. However, the vocal performances—particularly from Jaho, Oropesa, and Feola as Violetta—earn widespread praise.
